page0.text:
The lead actor exits the stage,
leaving only a wordless corpse.
And something
consumes it.
It leaves no body.
The wooden floor becomes a bottomless swamp, its crimson mass spreading out to consume the man's unmoving body.

page1.text:
It takes not only the man, but the thing he used to command.
The soul modeled after the Servant Caster falls to the black shadow.
That is not how things should be.
When a Servant loses and disappears, it goes back to the Holy Grail.
Something which violates this rule is subject to inevitable decay, no matter how powerful it is.

page2.text:
...
It cries without a sound.
In anguish, it bubbles and churns until it finally devours the first person.

page4.text:
It shuffles forward, like waves lapping on the shore.
It has no voice to scream, so it expresses pain with its entire body.

page6.text:
It has no words, no emotions.
From the beginning, it was never equipped with such functions.
